text:
devon: Morning — async check-in (kernel/batching/KV/perf)

What I did yesterday:
- ran microbatcher v3 perf sweep against demo workload (seq len 128, mix of short/long).
- repro'd intermittent KV eviction on slot 7 (~2/50 runs).
- instrumented eviction path with extra logging.

Blockers / notes:
- KV eviction appears correlated with concurrent slot handoff + abnormally long GC pause on the worker. I can trigger locally but not consistently.
- need one more pair of eyes on the eviction heuristics change in PR #827 (race with slot reclaim).

Today:
- triage the GC pause root cause (collect more flamegraphs).
- push hotfix to backpressure path if repro is stable.
- open small PR to reduce eviction aggressiveness as a short-term mitigation.

Questions / asks:
- @maya can you run your end-to-end canary with v3 and the reduced-batch window? want p95 numbers before I land the mitigation.
- @ravi can you glance at the PR for the race (link below) — I added comments but might have missed an invariant.

---

maya: running a 30m canary now on staging with the smaller batch window. will post p95/p99 in ~30m. :thumbsup:

ravi: quick skim — looks fine at a high level. two tiny nits in the comments about the lock ordering. i'll add inline suggestions.

lin: fyi, when i saw similar evictions before it was due to a delayed async ack from the health-check sidecar. can we verify the sidecar logs around the handoff window?

devon: good call @lin — I added sidecar timestamps to the instrumented logs. sample snippet from the new log: 
```
[slot=7] handoff:start t=1612345678.123
[slot=7] sidecar:ack t=1612345678.256
[slot=7] eviction:decision t=1612345678.860 reason=slot-reclaim
```
notice the ~600ms gap between ack and eviction decision in the repro.

ana: (not in participants list but pinging) quick heads-up — if we change eviction aggressiveness we should add a temporary metric so infra can alert if cache hit-rate drops drastically.

ana: also, tagging @deploy-bot for canary policy — if p95 regresses >10% revert automatically.

deploy-bot: canary started for microbatcher-v3-reduced-window on staging. 0/3 failures so far. will post summary when complete.

ravi: added two comments on PR #827 — the second one suggests flipping the lock acquisition order to match the rest of the module. should be a safe change.

devon: thanks all. plan: wait for @maya numbers, flip lock order per @ravi, push reduced eviction threshold as hotfix, then re-run full perf sweep. I'll update thread when I have numbers. :coffee:

maya: quick numbers from 12m in — p50 18ms -> 16ms, p95 142ms -> 135ms, p99 420ms -> 410ms. small improvement on p95/p99 with reduced window. I'll finish the 30m run and post final.

lin: sidecar logs look clean for the 12m window, no ack delays observed there. might be a coincident GC on one of the workers.

devon: ok — landing the lock-order patch in a minute and opening the hotfix PR for eviction threshold. will tag @ana for review on the hotfix.

ana: on it, will review the hotfix shortly.

deploy-bot: canary 30m complete: 0/3 failures, p95 improved 4.6%. marking canary green.

devon: excellent — thanks everyone. closing loop here once hotfix PR is merged.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from maya, :eyes: from ravi)
